name: DH116S-RW1
summary: DH116S-RW1 is a compact right-hand dexterous hand from Leadshine, supplied in white with CAN-FD communication. It has 11 degrees of freedom, including six active degrees of freedom, in a 147.54 × 73.53 × 26.35 mm package weighing 379 ±10 g. The manufacturer lists a maximum hook-grip load of 15 kg, maximum five-finger grip force of 50 N and IP30 protection.
